steps.note: Provide the required event title so it can be published and identified.
Configure the event as an RFQ, which supports bidding and awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one item so the award and resulting PO have a concrete line.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet before publishing.
Add the participant required for publishing and bidding.
Publish the RFQ so a vendor bid can be submitted.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Submit a bid for the invited vendor so the event can be awarded.
Verify that the bid was accepted.
Close bidding so awarding is allowed.
Allocate the awarded line to the vendor and submit the award proposal.
Confirm that the award proposal was created and submitted.
Complete the available approval flow and generate the purchase order request/results.
Verify that the resulting purchase orders list exactly the awarded event line item.
